posts.title: Resurrecting an old hack to build UI in GitHub READMEs
posts.description: I use a web design trick from the ’90s to render interactable buttons in GitHub’s highly constrained Markdown environment.

posts.title: Estimating the heights of New Yorkers from their scuff marks
posts.description: A commuter waiting for the train leans with one foot against the wall, and their shoe leaves a mark.

posts.title: Approve merge requests with your eyes closed
posts.description: With the rise of vibe coding, you can (and should) open a merge request without reading it. What’s missing is being able to approve it without reading it either — or even opening your eyes.
